metaTitle: How to Dry Wet Hiking Boots Safely
description: Dry wet hiking boots slowly with paper, airflow and removed insoles, and avoid fires, heaters and dryers that crack leather and melt glue.
directAnswer: Remove insoles, loosen laces, stuff boots with fresh paper and dry them at room temperature with a fan, changing paper as it dampens. Never use a fire, heater or dryer, which damage leather and glue.
